abilities.name: Cultivate plants
abilities.function: Plant one owned food unit from a living plant in a small hand-dug plot, where it may root as a new plant under the existing plant rules; inspect units, sites, plants and plot progress; cancel unfinished planting.
abilities.costs: Study: 3 rounds. Plant: inputStackId names one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled food unit (quantity 1; one plot per unit) gathered from a living plant; stock still on a plant is not owned. x, y: a 0.25 m plot within reach on ordinary meadow soil (.), waterlogging at most 0.1, soil moisture 0.3-1.2, 0.6 m clear of objects and people, fewer than 3 plants of that food within 5 m. Three paid rounds of 1 energy: loosen, place, cover; plant resumes paused work after rechecking reach, site, unit and energy. Inspect and inspect-progress: one round, 0.2 energy. Inspect: inputStackId checks a unit (with x, y also a site for it), or target a plant source or plot in reach. Inspect-progress: target a plot in reach. Maintain: refused at no cost. Cancel: one round, no energy. Harvest uses gather. No tool, water or seed is given.
abilities.effects: Loosening keeps the unit carried, owned and ageing. Placing moves it, with origin and age, into the open plot, where it cannot be eaten or used. Covering completes planting, not establishment: the plot becomes a propagule exactly like a naturally dispersed one, rooting only through actual temperature, light, soil moisture and season; cold, darkness or drought stall it; if the buried unit spoils first, the plot dies. On rooting, the unit becomes a new plant with no stock (ceiling 4), regrowing under the natural rule, harvested by anyone with gather; a ledger records growth and units produced and removed. Nothing is copied or guaranteed. A unit check reports decay, treatment, origin and whether it can be planted, never viability. Inspect-progress reports visible changes since your last look, else inconclusive; trial window 120 rounds, checks every 10; not a growth date. Maintain: no water transfer, amendment or hand-changeable obstruction exists. Records are unverified. An unworked round pauses; low energy, leaving reach or a changed site pause without charge; a lost or spoiled unit stops the work. Cancel, or death, before placing returns the unit once (where the person died); after placing, the unit stays uncovered, does not root and ages. No reward or refund.

execution.progress: Three paid one-round stages; job, reserved unit and plot persist across interruption; resuming pays only the remaining stages after revalidation; completion, failure, cancelling and death settle once. Growth runs only in ordinary simulation.

abilities.name: Prepare unheated food
abilities.function: Prepare whole units of your own food without heat, water or tools: each paid round checks one held unit by eye, brushes it by hand and moves it into your prepared lot; inspect food or progress; cancel unfinished work.
abilities.costs: Study: 2 rounds. Prepare: inputStackId is the exact item id of your own edible food stack, quantity the whole units to prepare (at most its whole units); one round and 0.5 energy per unit, so 7 units take 7 rounds and 3.5 energy. Every round is checked before any charge; prepare resumes your paused work (inputStackId and quantity may be omitted). Inspect (inputStackId of your own food) and inspect-progress (your latest preparation): one round, 0.2 energy, no food used. Cancel: one round, no energy. No vessel, water, fuel, tool or ground surface is used or given. Eating and giving use eat and give at their own costs.
abilities.effects: Each paid round separates one whole unit from the input, checks it by eye and brushes it by hand, held, never set on the ground. A usable unit joins one owned lot of the same food with unchanged quantity, origin, age, decay, nutrition and toxicity, recorded as raw, unheated, dry-brushed, safety unknown. Loose soil on food is not represented, so no debris is measured or removed and no cleanliness is claimed. A spoiled unit is reported unsuitable, stays unprepared and ends the work. Nothing is cooked, peeled, washed, made safe or kept fresher; food keeps ageing, and the planting trial treats prepared units as processed. The lot holds only completed units. Inspections record visible condition, treatment and your own eating record (not a safety test) as an unverified personal record. An unworked round, too little energy, or an input no longer yours with a whole unit pauses without charge. Cancel or death ends the work; completed units stay. No refund or reward; nobody is fed.

execution.progress: Paid one-unit rounds; job, input, unit outcomes and lot persist across pauses; resuming pays only the remaining units after revalidation; completion, an unsuitable unit, cancelling and death settle once. No unattended progress.

abilities.name: Vocal music
abilities.function: Hum or sing a short quiet phrase with your own voice for 1-3 rounds; nearby people hear each voiced round.
abilities.costs: Study: 2 rounds at 0.2 energy each; each hums a short practice phrase heard nearby (silent in pain or distress). hum or sing: rounds 1-3 (default 1), 0.5 energy per voiced round, no material. phrase: 2-8 notes {pitch: -4..4 steps from the home note 0, beats: 1-4}, or improvise=true. sing may add text (at most 240 characters, as tell). Shared by study, hum and sing: at most 3 voiced rounds in any 10 rounds, and 2 unvoiced rounds after 3 voiced rounds in a row or in one bout; a start must fit every requested round. Checked at start and each round: alive; no pain (an injury in the last round) or distress (satiety 0, body temperature below 7 or above 34); at least 0.5 energy. A refused start or resume costs nothing. resume continues a paused bout after fresh checks; cancel takes one round and no energy; both use only mode.
abilities.effects: Each voiced round is one segment at your position: everyone else living within 5 units (tell's hearing radius), seen or not, gets a heard event and heard-list entry with your mode, phrase, words and segment. Silence, refusals and pauses are not heard. The sound ends with each segment; no object, item, mark or lasting sound is made. Another action, a refused round, too little energy, a limit, pain or distress pauses the bout without charge; voiced segments and their energy are never refunded. Death ends the bout and any study. improvise=true derives 4-6 notes from your id and the start round (FNV-1a and xorshift32; from 0, steps of -2..+2 within -3..+3, back to 0), never at random. Each voiced round emits one segment at the performer's position, and every other living person within the tell radius (vision, 5) at the end of the round, seen or not, gets a heard event and an entry in the same bounded heard list (6 entries) with kind hum or sing, a sound label, the phrase, the words and the source segment, never a text field, so it reads as sound and can displace older spoken entries. Modeling assumptions: a segment renders the whole phrase once; quiet is a fixed label, with no loudness, tuning, tempo, attenuation or masking; no unconsciousness or vocal impairment is represented, so pain means an injury event in the last or current round and distress means satiety 0 or a body temperature outside 7-34, where forest physiology deals thermal damage; the limits are 3 voiced rounds in any 10 rounds and 2 unvoiced rounds after 3 voiced rounds in a row or in one bout, shared by study, hum and sing in one per-person record, a start must fit every requested round and a resume every remaining one, so after the two study rounds only one more voiced round fits until the window moves; study is the kernel's own and cannot be refused mid-way, so its rounds count as voiced and are heard as hummed practice phrases, except rounds in pain or distress, which still progress but stay silent and unvoiced, and the resumption after an energy pause is the kernel's; improvisation uses FNV-1a of the id and start round seeding xorshift32, never randomness, and study rounds hum the phrase of their own round; another action or a refused round pauses the bout at the end of that round, failed checks on a continuing round pause it without charge, repeating the start never resumes it, death ends the bout and any study with no continuation after respawn, and nothing is refunded; joining has no mechanics of its own, as each person uses their own mastery and hears the others. There is no object, item, process or lasting sound, only the per-person record of the last 10 rounds, rest, study rounds and the last bout, with the open bout shown as active work. There is no reward: no satisfaction rule; the install's practice rule cannot fire because the completion event never carries a qualified flag and nothing material changes; segment events carry no top-level progress fields, so they earn no routine progress credit; incentives are off here, and a check in expression-incentives gated on vocal-music@1 keeps segments and heard music from counting as contact, activity or use, so music never triggers answered, two-way or work-noticed, and voicing beside someone's made thing is not noticing it. Visuals: no components, only view metadata on events, with a voice or hum glyph only on executed segments, neutral paused, cancelled and ended states, completion only after every requested segment, and no badge.

position-loose-material@1 adds one general operation, position-loose-material (learning 1, one study round at 0.2 energy), registered last for this run's scope, that lays one carried loose unit on clear ground within reach at a chosen point and angle (radians) as an ordinary ground item. Modes: inspect (one round, 0.2 energy; target, optional x, y and angle) reports the unit and site facts with every unknown and unmet requirement and leaves a closed record, inspected or infeasible; place (target, x, y, angle, quantity 1) is stage 1, the same paid inspection (0.2), which reserves the exact unit in carried inventory (the item itself when it is one unit, otherwise one whole unit split exactly from it with every field kept, as collective-work reserves, mapped one to one) and keeps the requested transform, findings and remaining stage in an open work record shown as active work, then continues in the next round of the same action with stage 2 (0.5 energy): 2 rounds and 0.7 energy in all; inspect-progress (one round, 0.2) reports the open or latest record, the live checks for open work, and for a completed placement only what is in view; resume continues the unpaid stage 2 after fresh checks; cancel (one round, no energy) releases the reservation once and leaves the unit carried; paid effort is never refunded and every refusal comes before any cost. Reuse: stage 2 calls the ordinary drop of foundation-forest@1 (FOREST_BASE.handlers forest.drop) with the exact unit, so ownership, quantity, conservation, transfer validation, its 0.5 energy and the carried-to-ground id mapping of its dropped event are drop's own and its contract is unchanged; the operation then sets that ground item at the destination, records the transform on it (processing.groundPlacement) and adds a footprint record, an object of kind placed-loose-material (not solid, reserved, a rectangle of the rod length by its diameter at the angle), which nearby people observe with position, angle, footprint, material, origin, harvest round and placer, next to the ground item in their ordinary ground view; recovery is base pickup at its own cost, and after each round the footprint record ends (material-placement-removed) when the item is taken, divided or moved, and any stale placement record is cleared from items. Modeling assumptions: the only authoritative shape is the declared rod of small-combustion-source@1 (smallFireRod: 900 kg/m3, length 25 diameters, from the represented unit mass, so a branch unit is 0.991 x 0.0396 m), applied as prepare-ventilated-food-storage@1 does to branch, willow, birch and oak, but only to rigid wood (flexibility at most 3); willow therefore bends, and stone, food, every other material and worked, combined, equipment or partial units report their shape as unknown and cannot be placed, that mechanism being left for later development; the rod is straight, its curvature and surface are not represented; handling means the person already carries the unit and its rod fits the two-handed grip range of that package (1.5-5 cm), with no other strength or load limit; manual reach is the body radius plus the interaction range (0.87 m) to the centre, the reach pickup needs; supportable ground means every sample point (ends, quarter points, centre) is visible from the person and firm by the ex19 rule (not water, shallow water, a wet bank or waterlogging above 0.1); clear means the whole footprint lies inside the world and overlaps no living person (the placer included), no object of any kind (plants, signs, reserved surfaces and earlier placed units included) and no loose ground item; another action, lost reach or sight, an obstruction or energy below 0.5 pauses before stage 2 without charge, while a changed unit (any field except age, position, ownership and reservation), shape or ground ends the work as infeasible and frees the unit, so placing again makes a new paid inspection; death ends open work and releases the unit once to the death rules; drop's semantics stay, so the ground item gets a new id from drop (mapped) and pickup gives the taken item another new id, both keeping material, origin and harvest round; the footprint record's interaction range is the interaction range less the rod's half diagonal, so reaching it keeps the item within pickup reach; placed units persist under the existing rules and nothing arranges, maintains or improves them; two simultaneous placements with overlapping footprints are both rejected by the kernel's object conflict check. No reward: no satisfaction rule; the completion event never carries a qualified flag, so the install's practice rule cannot fire; events carry no top-level progress, elapsed or remaining numbers, so they earn no routine progress credit; a check in expression-incentives gated on this revision keeps placed units out of made work, so they never bring a work-noticed award even with incentives on (they are off here), and the other worlds replay unchanged. Visuals: a new placed-rod viewer drawing shows a placed unit as its rod at the recorded length, thickness and angle in its material colour (rotating itself, because the forest canvas draws package visuals unrotated, as rain-canopy does) and any other state as a dashed outline only; events carry loose-material view metadata (component, material, colour, transform, footprint, condition, status and reason) that stays provisional until completion, no object exists before it, and nothing marks an arrangement, quality or success; every existing drawing is unchanged.
